title: Naturalization English Reading and Writing Practice Bank

source.authority: USCIS Reading and Writing Vocabulary for the Naturalization Test
source.note: These are original Immigo practice sentences based on USCIS vocabulary. USCIS does not publish the live test sentences; these are not official USCIS test questions.

format.passingRule: A learner passes a section after one correct sentence, or completes three sentences without passing.
format.questionSentenceRule: Each mock exam randomly selects three reading sentences and three writing sentences from this bank.

reading.sentence: Where is the capital of the United States?
When do we vote for President?
What is the Bill of Rights?
Who can vote in the United States?

writing.sentence: The President lives in the White House.
George Washington was the first President.
The United States has fifty states.
